title: ENTITY SMP Plugin
description: This plugin, Anonymity, is a high-stakes tactical combat and social deduction system designed for hardcore survival or "Lifesteal" style servers. It centers around two core concepts: Hidden Identities and Powerful Relics.
body:
🎭 Anonymity: Tactical Identity & Relic Combat
Take your survival server to the next level with a system designed for mystery, paranoia, and elite power-scaling. Anonymity masks player identities and introduces powerful, limited-edition relics that change the flow of every battle.

⚠️ MANDATORY REQUIREMENT
This plugin relies on packet-level manipulation for identity masking. You MUST install ProtocolLib for this plugin to enable.

Download: ProtocolLib on SpigotMC

Compatible Version: 5.3.0 or higher (for Minecraft 1.21.1 support).

⚒️ Crafting Recipes
All relics require rare materials. Note: Ingredients like the Warden's Heart cannot be used for vanilla recipes (like the Mace) while this plugin is active!

💎 Shard of Anonymity

Recipe: Surround a Nether Star with 4 Amethyst Shards and 4 Echo Shards.

Effect: Grants 15% Lifesteal and keeps your name hidden.

🔊 Warden's Howl

Recipe: Place a Warden's Heart (Heavy Core) in the center, surrounded by 4 Goat Horns and 4 Sculk Catalysts.

Effect: Releases a sonic blast inflicting Darkness and Slowness IV.

🗡️ Soul-Binder Dagger

Recipe: One Netherite Sword combined with 4 Soul Sand and 4 Ghast Tears.

Effect: Low raw damage but "binds" the soul of the victim for tracking.

🔭 Sight-Glass

Recipe: A Spyglass surrounded by 8 Glowstone Dust.

Effect: Zoom in on players to reveal their Exact HP and Armor Enchants.

📡 Pulse Tracker

Recipe: A Compass surrounded by 4 Recovery Compasses and 4 Redstone Blocks.

Effect: A proximity-based tracker that pulses faster as you approach enemies.

⚔️ Global Relic Limits
To maintain server balance, each relic has a Global Limit. If the limit is reached (e.g., 5/5 Shards), the recipe will be blocked in the crafting table until one is destroyed or lost.

🛠️ Technical Features
Anti-Exploit System: Prevents rare relic ingredients from being "wasted" on vanilla items.

Database Persistence: All relic ownership and cooldowns are saved via SQLite.

Optimized Performance: Uses XSeries for cross-version audio and visual effects.
